single_strongest_route_recommendation.rationale: Mount Nuolja sits directly in the Scandes mountain barrier. Orographic flow-regime transitions between low-level flow blocking (Fr < 1.0, trapped valley fog/stratus) and forced mountain overtopping (Fr >= 1.0, wave cloudiness) govern local cloud optical depth. This route evaluates continuous layer-integrated Brunt-Vaisala stability N and barrier-normal wind U_perp, replacing the approximate 2-point shortcut evaluated in Stage 8.24 with full scientific fidelity. It is 100% causally available from MEPS vertical profiles and 30m DEM for all 347 origins.
